about_short_description.short_description: All-in-one CRM. One workspace for all your relationships: Sales, Recruiting, Fundraising, Partnerships, and more.

product.name: folk CRM
product.description: A cloud-based CRM platform designed to manage and track relationships across sales, recruiting, fundraising, and partnerships in a single workspace.

product.name: folkX Chrome Extension
product.description: A browser extension that imports and enriches lead details from LinkedIn directly into folk CRM without leaving the platform.

product.name: 1-click Enrichment
product.description: An AI-powered feature that finds emails, identifies key connections, and imports prospect data to enrich lead profiles quickly.

product.name: Messages & Sequences
product.description: A CRM feature that uses AI to generate personalized message drafts, schedule communications, and automate outreach sequences.

product.name: Integrations
product.description: Connects folk CRM with emails, calendars, social platforms, and over 6000 other tools to centralize relationship data.

product.name: Pipelines
product.description: A collaborative tool for managing deals with shared pipelines, customizable roles, permissions, and sales dashboards.
